info.name: KHR_LIGHT_RING
info.comment: Local copy of the ANARI registry extension, trimmed to what this device implements. Omitted registry parameters: 'falloffAngle' (Cycles area-light spread has a fixed built-in soft edge; setting it warns and is ignored) and 'innerRadius' (no Cycles analog for an annulus; nonzero values warn and the light stays a full disc). 'intensityDistribution' values modulate the resolved radiance: 1D is rotationally symmetric over the polar angle from 'direction' (uniform on [0,pi], >=2 entries), 2D rows are C-halfplanes uniform over [0,2pi) anchored at 'c0', increasing right-handed around 'direction' (IES LM-63 Type C winding). The distribution's angular mapping is exact under rigid/uniform-scale instance transforms; non-uniform instance scaling skews the lookup angles slightly. Keep info.name equal to the official extension name so introspection still advertises it.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: the axis the ring is pointing at

parameters.name: intensity
parameters.description: overall amount of light emitted in a direction in W/sr

parameters.name: power
parameters.description: overall amount of light energy emitted in W

parameters.name: radiance
parameters.description: the amount of light emitted by a point on the light source in a direction in W/sr/m^2

parameters.name: intensityDistribution
parameters.description: luminous intensity distribution for photometric lights

parameters.name: c0
parameters.description: direction of the C0-(half)plane (only used with a 2D intensityDistribution)
